Abstract.AbstractText: The complete mitochondrial genome (mitogenome) of the Gymnocephalus cernua has been studied. The genome sequence was 16,614 bp in length, including the typical structure of 22 transfer RNA genes, 13 protein-coding genes, two ribosomal RNA genes, and the non-coding control region. The overall base composition of G. cernua mitogenome is 27.84% A, 27.60% T, 16.61% G, and 27.94% C, with a high A + T content of 55.45%. The complete mitochondrial genome of G. cernua provides basic genome data for relative studies on Perciformes.
